library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

#MT2 team :
stats <- read.table("Downloads/ultimate_pass_data_2026-04-23_14-00-36.csv", sep=",", header=T)

#Challenger team
stats <- read.table("Downloads/ultimate_pass_data_2026-04-23_23-55-31.csv", sep=",", header=T)

#MT1 game 1
stats <- read.table("Downloads/ultimate_pass_data_2026-04-26_12-09-08 (MT1 Panda vs Steal).csv", sep=",", header=T)

#MT1 game 2
stats <- read.table("Downloads/ultimate_pass_data_2026-05-04_14-58-14 (MT1 Panda vs BN1).csv", sep=",", header=T)

#MT1 game 3
stats <- read.table("Downloads/ultimate_pass_data_2026-05-09_19-47-10 (MT1 Polar vs Rebel).csv", sep=",", header=T)

#MT1 game 4
stats <- read.table("Downloads/ultimate_pass_data_2026-05-10_19-30-32 (MT1 Polar vs Curve).csv", sep=",", header=T)

### First graph : completions, disk touches and goals

totcompl <- length(which(stats$Outcome!="Turnover"))
totturn <- length(which(stats$Outcome=="Turnover"))
totpasses <- totcompl+totturn

stats_summary <- data.frame(Outcome = c("Completed", "Turnover"),
           Occurence = c(totcompl,totturn),
           Percentage = c(totcompl*100/totpasses, totturn*100/totpasses))

allcompl <- ggplot(stats_summary,aes(x="", y=Percentage, fill=Outcome)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("aquamarine3", "indianred3")) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 4) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title=paste0("Pass attempts = ",totpasses))

totF <- length(which(stats$From=="F"))
totM <- length(which(stats$From=="M"))
totpasses <- totF+totM

stats_summary <- data.frame(Gender = c("F", "M"),
                            Occurence = c(totF,totM),
                            Percentage = c(totF*100/totpasses, totM*100/totpasses))

alltouches <- ggplot(stats_summary,aes(x="", y=Percentage, fill=Gender)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2", "darkorange3")) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 4) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title=paste0("Disc Touches = ",totpasses))

totF <- length(which(stats$To=="F" & stats$Outcome=="Assist"))
totM <- length(which(stats$To=="M" & stats$Outcome=="Assist"))
totpasses <- totF+totM

stats_summary <- data.frame(Gender = c("F", "M"),
                            Occurence = c(totF,totM),
                            Percentage = c(totF*100/totpasses, totM*100/totpasses))

allgoals <- ggplot(stats_summary,aes(x="", y=Percentage, fill=Gender)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2", "darkorange3")) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 4) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title=paste0("Goals = ",totpasses))

allcompl | alltouches | allgoals

### Second graph : mixed play total pass attempts

stats$passtype = paste0(stats$From,stats$To)

stats_mixity <- as.data.frame(table(stats$passtype))
names(stats_mixity) <- c("Passtype","Occurence")
stats_mixity$Percentage <- stats_mixity$Occurence / sum(stats_mixity$Occurence) * 100

all_mix <- ggplot(stats_mixity,aes(x="", y=Percentage, fill=Passtype)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "MM" = "darkorange3",
    "MF" = "darkslategray",
    "FM" = "cyan4",
    "FF" = "gold2"
  )) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title="Total attempts")
all_mix

stats_mf <- stats[which(stats$passtype=="MF"),]
totcompl <- length(which(stats_mf$Outcome!="Turnover"))

totpasses <- totcompl+totturn

stats_ff <- stats[which(stats$passtype=="FF"),]
totcompl <- length(which(stats_ff$Outcome!="Turnover"))
totturn <- length(which(stats_ff$Outcome=="Turnover"))
totpasses <- totcompl+totturn

stats_summary <- data.frame(Outcome = c("Completed", "Turnover"),
                            Occurence = c(totcompl,totturn),
                            Percentage = c(totcompl*100/totpasses, totturn*100/totpasses))

ff <- ggplot(stats_summary,aes(x="", y=Percentage, fill=Outcome)) +

### Fourth graph : pass type per outcome

stats_completed <- stats[which(stats$Outcome!="Turnover"),]

stats_mixity <- as.data.frame(table(stats_completed$passtype))
names(stats_mixity) <- c("Passtype","Occurence")
stats_mixity$Percentage <- stats_mixity$Occurence / sum(stats_mixity$Occurence) * 100
